'''Grimyk''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was on [[Cademimu V]] during the [[Cademimu uprising]] by the governor [[Chornarov]]. A strike team sent to take control of the Cademimu missile batteries from Chornarov engaged Grimyk and killed him.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Grimyk appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss during the "Cademimu" flashpoint.
